program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # diff-pair gm/Id (low Vgs -> tail headroom, big area for 1/f)
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # diff-pair L
    "itail": (100e-6, 60e-6, 160e-6),
    "gbw":   (38e6, 25e6, 55e6),     # nominal GBW target -> sets Cc
    "I6":    (450e-6, 250e-6, 600e-6),  # second stage current
    "gmid6": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # PMOS CS gm/Id
    "L6":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Lload": (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS mirror load L (first-stage gain)
    "gmidn": (13.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # NMOS bias/mirror gm/Id
    "rzk":   (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),        # Rz = rzk/gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    itail, I6 = p["itail"], p["I6"]
    Ln = 1.0

    # ---- NMOS bias mirror family (same L, gm/Id, sized at same vds for exact ratios)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], Ln, iref, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], Ln, itail, vds=0.6)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], Ln, I6, vds=0.6)

    # ---- first stage
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], itail / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 9.0, p["Lload"], itail / 2, vds=0.8)
    # ---- second stage
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid6"], p["L6"], I6, vds=0.9)

    # ---- compensation
    Cc = m1.gm / (2 * PI * p["gbw"])
    Rz = p["rzk"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt, m=2)
    # diff pair: diode side gate = vinn, output side gate = vinp (non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1, m=2)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1, m=2)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3, m=2)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3, m=2)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m6, m=8)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7, m=8)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "x", "nc", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nc", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    CLt = cl + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cc + C1 * CLt + Cc * CLt))
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    rz_eff = Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm
    fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * rz_eff) if rz_eff > 0 else 1e12
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + itail + I6)
    slew = min(itail / Cc, I6 / (CLt + Cc))
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 / (2 * PI * 0.8 * ugbw)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    vn_th = math.sqrt(2 * (8 * kT / 3) / m1.gm * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm))
    noise = 4.0 * vn_th  # crude allowance for 1/f at 1 kHz
    swing = 1.8 - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.15
    cmrr = db(2 * m3.gm / mt.gds * 0.5)
    psrr = db(A1 * A2) - 25

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "noise_1k": noise,
               "swing": swing, "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr}
